name: Ancient script specialist
design: Tall angular young adult male with triangular but clearly Yautja bronze biomask, high flattened central ridge and two lower seam grooves, thick swept-back scalp tendrils divided into three long groups. Green sleeveless scholar overcoat over modest full grey undersuit, moss segmented apron and brown diagonal strap harness, slim silver forearm guards.
